title: Catch‑All Routes
description: Handle multiple URL segments with [...slug].js – ideal for nested categories or file browsers.

slides.title: Beyond a Single Parameter 🚋
slides.content:
# Catch‑All Routes `[...slug].js`

Sometimes you need to match **any number** of path segments:

* `/blog/a`
* `/blog/a/b`
* `/blog/a/b/c`

Create `pages/blog/[...slug].js`.

`router.query.slug` will be an **array** of segments: `['a', 'b', 'c']`.

slides.title: Catch‑All Blog Page (pages/blog/[...slug].js)

quizData.question: A file `pages/shop/[...categories].js` with URL `/shop/electronics/phones`. What is `router.query.categories`?
quizData.explanation: Catch‑all routes collect all segments into an array. The query parameter name is whatever you put inside the brackets (here `categories`).
